description: Propose a new capability as a declarative JSON recipe. Each step names one connector or one catalog entry by id. It is validated; a valid recipe is stored as a public DRAFT only. The answer has validation_status, publication_status and tests_status. Only with run_tests: true are the test_cases (at most 3) of a recipe made only of computed operations run as tests now (no outside call; one run toward the daily run limit); otherwise tests_status is not_run. No data source is called. Limited per caller and per day.

need.description: optional: the need in a few English keywords

as.description: name of this step's result (default s1, s2, ...)

entry.description: a catalog entry id (tool_id of a search result)

params.description: per parameter: a literal, {input: name}, {step: name, path: 'a.b'} or {calc: ...}

tool.description: hash of a stored capability used as a part

run_tests.description: optional: true = run the test_cases (at most 3) of a recipe made only of computed operations now, no outside call, one run toward the daily run limit; default: tests not run

name: propose_capability
